name: LIK:Echolocation
source:
labor->information->knowledge:echolocation, or LIK:E for short, is a short visual novel about being unable to see, and echolocation as a primary means of sensing the world.

It's also about the difficulty and vulnerability involved with any act of self-expression — or specifically in trying to know anything beyond your own feelings, whether the world reciprocates them or not.

[From [url=https://mousewifegames.itch.io/echolocation]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
劳动->信息->知识：回声定位，简称LIK:E，是一部关于无法看见以及回声定位作为感知世界的主要手段的短篇视觉小说。

它还涉及到任何自我表达行为所涉及的困难和脆弱性——或者特别是试图了解超出你自己感受的任何事情，无论世界是否回应它们。

[来自[url=https://mousewifegames.itch.io/echolocation]Itch.io[/url]]
